scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/prompts && npm run build --workspace=packages/integrations-sdk
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.typecheck:api: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api
scripts.typecheck:web: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build:packages && npm run prisma:generate && npm run build:web
